parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposure is high and mostly state-imposed: visa/entry screening can refuse cases over sex-marker discrepancies or suspicion of misrepresentation, with possible lifetime fraud findings; document mismatch raises forced outing. Government-facility bans in many jurisdictions, some criminal trespass after refusal to leave, plus reported passport/visa detentions and immigration-custody abuse create tier-1/2 severity. Resident protections and pending litigation slightly temper this but do not offset active border/facility rules for travellers. No trans-execution or campaign is documented, so not near 0.0. Overall high risk, below severe because consequences are usually denial/refusal or custody harm rather than automatic prosecution.
